steps.note: Start a multi-stage project creation flow suitable for an RFQ.
Ensure the RFQ counter-offer control is available for the test.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Configure the event as an RFQ so counter-offer activity is exercised on the intended stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add a product so the RFQ can receive and counter a bid.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a bidding schedule required for publication.
Invite one QA vendor to submit the bid.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the invited vendor submit the original bid that will be countered.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer comparison grid where the vendor bid can be countered.
Send the buyer's counter offer against the vendor's submitted bid.
Confirm the buyer grid records that the counter offer was initiated.
Have the vendor answer the pending counter offer by accepting it.
Confirm the buyer-side response grid shows the counter offer as accepted.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer after both negotiation actions are complete.
Verify the activity drawer contains an entry referring to the counter offer.
Verify the activity drawer records the answering outcome.
